metadata.case_name: CHENG WAI HUNG AND ANOTHER v. KWOK FUK KWAN JAMES AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: salesman selling CD, VCD and electronic components in the V Theatre

injuries.description: sprained neck / soft tissue injury on the back of his neck
source: As a result of the traffic accident, the 1st Plaintiff suffered a sprained neck.
On examination he was diagnosed to suffer soft tissue injury on the back of his neck.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: soft tissue sprain/contusion injury to her neck and low back
source: Dr. Wong believed that she probably sustained soft tissue sprain/contusion injury to her neck and low back as a result of the accident.

manifestations.description: on and off neck pain, which would occasionally wake him up at night
restricted neck movements and neck stiffness
numbness on his left upper limb intermittently
his left hand cannot raise or carry heavy objects
has stopped to play sports like basketball, badminton, table tennis and soccer after the accident
occasional neck and low back pain upon prolonged walking and sitting for 2-3 hours (pain relieved by changing posture)
felt dizzy a few times a week, which lasted for half a day

treatments_received: Attended Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital and discharged same day
3 sessions of physiotherapy in April and May 2005
Attended Robert Black evening clinic for further treatment
treatments_future: Future medical treatment recommended by Dr. Lau (estimated cost in private sector $8,000 to $10,000) - 3 weeks' leave

losses.description: his left hand cannot raise or carry heavy objects

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: has stopped to play sports like basketball, badminton, table tennis and soccer after the accident
changed to a job with lesser working hours and lower salary (conscious decision to be less troubled by neck pain)
